confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: A sense of being accepted as part of a group or place.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: Acceptance and felt membership cannot be inferred from physical grouping.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: To support this sense, a still should show Acceptance and felt membership cannot be inferred from physical grouping.; Standing among a group does not show feeling included. can otherwise be mistaken for it.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: To put out a new shoot or bud.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: A fresh shoot emerging from a seed or plant stem.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: An image would need to establish A fresh shoot emerging from a seed or plant stem.. Seeing A mature leafy plant does not show a new shoot appearing. alone would leave the sense uncertain.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: To push off a surface and move into the air.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: Show the event in progress: to push off a surface and move into the air.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: The selected definition describes to push off a surface and move into the air. This makes action the most direct visual-evidence class.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: To communicate using spoken words.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: Show a person producing spoken words; a visible listener is not required by this definition.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: The selected definition names the action of communicating through spoken words. A second participant is not required by the wording, so action alone is sufficient.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: To lose blood from a wound or bodily opening.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: A visible flow of blood from a body or wound.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: Sparse evidence routing: do not label an incidental bearer, medium, outcome, or setting as a separate category. The selected sense is: To lose blood from a wound or bodily opening.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: An image visible in a mirror or another reflective surface.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: Show a recognizable image of an object or person appearing in a reflective surface, with the reflected image visibly linked to its source.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: A reflection is an image (entity-like visible content) whose identity depends on its relation to the reflective source. Relation is primary because the selected definition explicitly makes the image visible in a mirror or reflective surface.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: To let liquid or gas escape through an unintended opening.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: Fluid escaping from a seam, crack, or hole.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: Sparse evidence routing: do not label an incidental bearer, medium, outcome, or setting as a separate category. The selected sense is: To let liquid or gas escape through an unintended opening.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: Small bubbles forming across heated liquid in a cooking vessel.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: Sparse evidence routing: do not label an incidental bearer, medium, outcome, or setting as a separate category. The selected sense is: To cook gently in liquid just below boiling.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: An image would need to establish A fresh shoot emerging from a seed or plant stem.. Seeing A mature leafy plant does not show a new shoot appearing. alone would leave the sense uncertain.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: The boundary where land meets a body of water.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: A visible edge joining land and water.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: To support this sense, a still should show A visible edge joining land and water.; A wet patch inland does not establish a shoreline. can otherwise be mistaken for it.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: To let liquid or gas escape through an unintended opening.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: Fluid escaping from a seam, crack, or hole.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: Sparse evidence routing: do not label an incidental bearer, medium, outcome, or setting as a separate category. The selected sense is: To let liquid or gas escape through an unintended opening.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: On every occasion or at all times.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: An absolute claim spans time beyond any single observation.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: This reading depends on An absolute claim spans time beyond any single observation.; One consistent-looking example cannot prove always. is a plausible lookalike but does not settle it.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: To mix into a liquid until a solid is no longer distinct.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: A solid dispersing through a liquid, often with a fading boundary.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: To support this sense, a still should show A solid dispersing through a liquid, often with a fading boundary.; A solid merely floating in liquid has not dissolved. can otherwise be mistaken for it.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: To lose blood from a wound or bodily opening.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: A visible flow of blood from a body or wound.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: Sparse evidence routing: do not label an incidental bearer, medium, outcome, or setting as a separate category. The selected sense is: To lose blood from a wound or bodily opening.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: In most instances or on the customary occasion.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: A usual pattern requires multiple instances, not a single frame.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: An image would need to establish A usual pattern requires multiple instances, not a single frame.. Seeing A scene that looks routine may be exceptional. alone would leave the sense uncertain.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: To produce open flowers.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: A flower opening or newly opened on a plant.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: This reading depends on A flower opening or newly opened on a plant.; A cut flower in a vase does not show a plant blooming. is a plausible lookalike but does not settle it.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: Fitted together so that parts catch or pass through one another.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: Parts visibly engage and resist separating in a simple direction.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: The visible test is Parts visibly engage and resist separating in a simple direction.. A scene with Parts pressed side by side are not necessarily interlocked. would not be enough on its own.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: On very few occasions.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: Rarity is a frequency claim requiring a comparison set.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: The visible test is Rarity is a frequency claim requiring a comparison set.. A scene with An unusual-looking scene does not establish how often it occurs. would not be enough on its own.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: A reddish-brown metal used in pipes, wiring, and objects.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: The metal itself, such as a cut surface or wire.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: The deciding cue is The metal itself, such as a cut surface or wire.; Copper-colored plastic is only a visual imitation. could occur without the selected meaning.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: Having joint access to the same physical resource with another participant.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: A contextual illustration of participants accessing the same resource.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: Joint access is a relation; agreement and entitlement can require nonvisual context.

confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.definition: To begin growing from a seed.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.requiredEvidence: A seed opening as a root or shoot emerges.
confidentWrongLabelsAt90Percent.annotationRationale: The visible test is A seed opening as a root or shoot emerges.. A scene with A fully grown plant nearby does not show a seed beginning to grow. would not be enough on its own.
